system.description:
You gain [Cancel (Natural, Natural):10] when you and your allies in the same Sq perform an action with the [Scout] tag, and you gain +2 to the "Detect Unusual" check. A dull outdoor work armor. Made from the hides of several magical beasts, infused with various resins from the forest, it boasts an unexpectedly strong defense. Additionally, its magic radiates around the wearer, making it easier to block detection and conceal one's presence. It also subdues the surrounding flora and fauna, making them hesitate to attack.

Golden Hairball [Core Material] (220G) + Academia Robe (480G) + [Magic Catalyst 11] (120G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (440G)
